en.headline: New batch of Tung Chung public housing concrete cores all meet strength standards
en.dek: Housing Department said 36 further core samples from the affected blocks tested 26 to 83 percent above the required strength, bringing the verified share to 67 percent.
body: The Housing Department reported on Wednesday that a fresh batch of 36 concrete core samples taken from the Tung Chung Area 42 public housing project had all exceeded design strength requirements.

The samples, drawn from floors where earlier cube tests had failed contractual standards in Blocks 3, 4 and 5, recorded strengths 26 to 83 percent above the specified values. Combined with 12 cores already cleared the previous day, 67 percent of the cores tested so far now meet or exceed the required strength.

The department said the remaining results are expected by Friday. Once all data are in, the project team will decide whether any structural components need further review or remedial work before concrete pouring at the affected locations can resume.

Impact on the overall construction programme is assessed as minor. Routine cube tests for Blocks 1 and 6 continue to satisfy contractual requirements. The department has directed the contractor to suspend work at the problematic spots pending the full set of results.

zh.headline: 東涌公屋新一批混凝土芯樣本全部達標
zh.dek: 房屋署公布再有36個芯樣強度高出標準26%至83%，累計已測67%樣本合格，餘下結果預計周五出爐。
body: 房屋署周三表示，東涌42區公營房屋項目再取得新一批共36個混凝土芯強度測試結果，全部符合設計及合約要求，強度高出標準26%至83%。
樣本平均分布在第3座22樓、第4座5樓及第5座5樓早前發現問題的區域。連同前日公布的首批12個合格結果，目前已測得的67%樣本均高出標準，全部達標。
署方預計周五可取得全部混凝土芯抗壓強度測試結果。工程團隊會按完整數據決定是否需要審視相關結構組件，並在有需要時要求承建商提交改善方案，經批准後方可恢復涉事位置的混凝土澆灌。
目前評估對整體工程進度影響輕微。第1座及第6座的恆常混凝土方塊強度測試結果一直符合要求。房屋署已要求承建商暫停相關位置的澆灌工作。
